title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden Tracking Area Identities to be stored in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming. This IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

entities.name: Message sent via satellite NG-RAN access
entities.description: Condition that the message is transmitted over satellite NG-RAN access, which determines whether the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included.

entities.name: Store forbidden TAI(s) in 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming list
entities.description: System behavior to store the indicated forbidden Tracking Area Identities in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is guarded by the condition that the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE establishes the property that the UE stores the indicated forbidden tracking areas in the 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming list.
